arguments.query:
SELECT DISTINCT p.merchant
FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments` p
JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.merchant_data` m
  ON p.merchant = m.merchant
WHERE p.year = 2023
  AND p.card_scheme = 'SwiftCharge'
  AND p.aci IN ('B', 'C')
  AND m.merchant_category_code IN (5411, 5412, 5499, 5912, 5812, 5813, 5911, 5983)
ORDER BY p.merchant
